## 1. Verdict
Deterministic mutation of canonical/out2.srt: byte at offset 32 (the 'H' of "Hello",
0x48) XOR 0x80 -> 0xc8 — verified byte-exact by python3
(`flip2_032 == base[:32] + bytes([base[32]^0x80]) + base[33:]` -> True). Name decodes as
flip = XOR 0x80, parent out2, offset 032. Effect: 'H' becomes 0xc8 (invalid UTF-8), so
cue 1's text decodes through the Windows-1252 fallback as "Èello world" (0xc8 -> 'È').
Consumed by the corpus read_dir test (srt_fuzz_survival.rs:56-70). Nothing wrong with the
fixture.
